var started=false;
function startExperience(){
  if(started)return; started=true;
  var ld=document.getElementById('loader');
  ld.classList.add('fade');
  setTimeout(function(){ld.style.display='none';},1500);
  setTimeout(startMusic,400);
}

// ─── MUSIC ───
var TNAMES=["Selene — Ethereal Butterfly","Selene — Ethereal Butterfly I","Selene — Ethereal Butterfly II","Selene's Quiet Halo","Selene's Hollow Light"];
var TRACKS=5,curTrack=0,isPlaying=false,audioReady=false;
function getAudio(i){return document.getElementById('track'+i);}
function startMusic(){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  a.volume=parseFloat(document.getElementById('vol-slider').value);
  a.currentTime=0;
  var p=a.play();
  if(p)p.then(function(){isPlaying=true;updateUI();}).catch(function(){});
  a.onended=function(){nextTrack();};
  a.ontimeupdate=function(){updateProg();};
  a.onloadedmetadata=function(){document.getElementById('t-dur').textContent=fmt(a.duration);};
  audioReady=true;
}
function updateUI(){
  document.getElementById('track-name').textContent=TNAMES[curTrack].toUpperCase();
  document.getElementById('track-num').textContent='Track '+(curTrack+1)+' / '+TRACKS;
  document.getElementById('play-btn').textContent=isPlaying?'⏸':'▶';
}
function updateProg(){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);if(!a.duration)return;
  document.getElementById('pb-fill').style.width=((a.currentTime/a.duration)*100)+'%';
  document.getElementById('t-cur').textContent=fmt(a.currentTime);
}
function fmt(s){if(!s||isNaN(s))return'0:00';return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+(Math.floor(s%60)<10?'0':'')+Math.floor(s%60);}
function togglePlay(){
  if(!audioReady){startMusic();return;}
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  if(isPlaying){a.pause();isPlaying=false;}else{a.play().catch(function(){});isPlaying=true;}
  updateUI();
}
function switchTrack(n){
  var p=getAudio(curTrack);p.pause();p.onended=null;p.ontimeupdate=null;p.currentTime=0;
  curTrack=((n%TRACKS)+TRACKS)%TRACKS;
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  a.volume=parseFloat(document.getElementById('vol-slider').value);
  a.currentTime=0;
  a.onended=function(){nextTrack();};
  a.ontimeupdate=function(){updateProg();};
  a.onloadedmetadata=function(){document.getElementById('t-dur').textContent=fmt(a.duration);};
  if(isPlaying)a.play().catch(function(){});
  updateUI();
  document.getElementById('pb-fill').style.width='0%';
  document.getElementById('t-cur').textContent='0:00';
}
function nextTrack(){switchTrack(curTrack+1);}
function prevTrack(){switchTrack(curTrack-1);}
function setVol(v){getAudio(curTrack).volume=parseFloat(v);}
function seekAudio(e){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);if(!a.duration)return;
  var r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  a.currentTime=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*a.duration;
}

// ─── VIDEO ───
function playVid(i){
  var v=document.getElementById('vplay'+i),ov=document.getElementById('vov'+i);
  if(v.paused){v.muted=true;v.play().catch(function(){});ov.style.opacity='0';ov.style.pointerEvents='none';}
  else{v.pause();ov.style.opacity='1';ov.style.pointerEvents='auto';}
}

setInterval(function(){cur2.style.left=mx+'px';cur2.style.top=my+'px';},90);

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent.trim()).catch(function(){});
  var o=el.textContent;el.textContent='✓ Copied!';
  setTimeout(function(){el.textContent=o;},2200);
}

// ─── BUTTERFLIES ───
var bCv=document.getElementById('btfly-cv'),bCtx=bCv.getContext('2d');
var butterflies=[],mPts=[];
function resizeB(){bCv.width=window.innerWidth;bCv.height=window.innerHeight;}
resizeB();window.addEventListener('resize',resizeB);
var STARS=[];
for(var si=0;si<200;si++)STARS.push({x:Math.random()*3200,y:Math.random()*2200,r:.3+Math.random()*1.9,spd:.001+Math.random()*.004,op:Math.random()});
function Btfly(x,y,big){
  this.x=x||Math.random()*bCv.width;this.y=y||Math.random()*bCv.height;
  this.vx=(Math.random()-.5)*.7;this.vy=(Math.random()-.5)*.7;
  this.angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;this.turn=(Math.random()-.5)*.055;
  this.sz=big?(9+Math.random()*16):(4+Math.random()*13);
  this.phase=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;this.wSpd=.05+Math.random()*.09;
  this.life=big?(.5+Math.random()*.4):(.25+Math.random()*.65);
  this.decay=big?(.0012+Math.random()*.002):(.0007+Math.random()*.0015);
  var idx=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  var hues=[[45,85,68],[28,88,58],[220,75,62],[50,50,95]];
  this.h=hues[idx][0]+(Math.random()-.5)*18;this.s=hues[idx][1];this.l=hues[idx][2];
  this.glow=this.sz>10;
}
Btfly.prototype.update=function(){
  this.angle+=this.turn+(Math.random()-.5)*.022;
  this.vx+=Math.cos(this.angle)*.028;this.vy+=Math.sin(this.angle)*.028;
  this.vx*=.965;this.vy*=.965;
  this.x+=this.vx;this.y+=this.vy;
  this.phase+=this.wSpd;this.life-=this.decay;
  if(this.x<-45)this.x=bCv.width+45;if(this.x>bCv.width+45)this.x=-45;
  if(this.y<-45)this.y=bCv.height+45;if(this.y>bCv.height+45)this.y=-45;
};
Btfly.prototype.draw=function(){
  var w=Math.abs(Math.sin(this.phase));
  bCtx.save();bCtx.translate(this.x,this.y);
  bCtx.rotate(Math.atan2(this.vy,this.vx)+Math.PI/2);
  bCtx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,this.life*.88);
  var col='hsla('+this.h+','+this.s+'%,'+this.l+'%,';
  if(this.glow){
    var gr=bCtx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,this.sz*4.5);
    gr.addColorStop(0,col+'.32)');gr.addColorStop(1,col+'0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=gr;bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.arc(0,0,this.sz*4.5,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  }
  bCtx.fillStyle=col+'.9)';
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(-this.sz*.56*w,-this.sz*.36,this.sz*.66*w+1,this.sz*.44,-.35,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(this.sz*.56*w,-this.sz*.36,this.sz*.66*w+1,this.sz*.44,.35,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  var c2='hsla('+(this.h+18)+','+this.s+'%,'+Math.min(100,this.l+14)+'%,.74)';
  bCtx.fillStyle=c2;
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(-this.sz*.44*w,this.sz*.28,this.sz*.5*w+1,this.sz*.32,.22,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(this.sz*.44*w,this.sz*.28,this.sz*.5*w+1,this.sz*.32,-.22,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.fillStyle='hsla('+this.h+',35%,90%,.92)';
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(0,0,1.5,this.sz*.46,0,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.restore();
};
for(var bi=0;bi<75;bi++){var nb=new Btfly();nb.life=Math.random()*.7+.2;butterflies.push(nb);}
document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
  if(Math.random()>.52)butterflies.push(new Btfly(e.clientX+(Math.random()-.5)*22,e.clientY+(Math.random()-.5)*22,true));
  if(butterflies.length>115)butterflies.splice(0,8);

});

(function bLoop(){
  var t=Date.now()*.001;
  bCtx.clearRect(0,0,bCv.width,bCv.height);
  STARS.forEach(function(s){
    var sx=s.x%bCv.width,sy=s.y%bCv.height;
    var op=Math.max(0,.18+Math.sin(t*s.spd*120+s.x)*.22);
    bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.arc(sx,sy,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    bCtx.fillStyle='rgba(255,248,218,'+op+')';bCtx.fill();
  });
  var orbC=['rgba(212,175,55,','rgba(255,140,0,','rgba(123,79,160,','rgba(68,136,255,'];
  for(var oi=0;oi<4;oi++){
    var ox=bCv.width*(.14+oi*.24)+Math.sin(t*.24+oi*1.9)*(bCv.width*.06);
    var oy=bCv.height*.5+Math.cos(t*.19+oi*2.1)*(bCv.height*.15);
    var og=bCtx.createRadialGradient(ox,oy,0,ox,oy,60+oi*20);
    og.addColorStop(0,orbC[oi]+'.058)');og.addColorStop(1,orbC[oi]+'0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=og;bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.arc(ox,oy,60+oi*20,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  }
  mPts=mPts.filter(function(p){
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.life-=.044;
    var g=bCtx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,p.sz);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(212,175,55,'+p.life+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,0,0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=g;bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.sz,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
    return p.life>0;
  });
  butterflies=butterflies.filter(function(b){b.update();b.draw();return b.life>0;});
  if(butterflies.length<65)butterflies.push(new Btfly());
  requestAnimationFrame(bLoop);
})();

// ─── PARALLAX & SCROLL ───
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
  var sy=window.scrollY,dH=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
  document.getElementById('prog').style.width=(sy/dH*100)+'%';
  document.querySelectorAll('.cbg,.pximg,.pxi').forEach(function(img){
    var sec=img.closest('section')||img.closest('.px-full');
    if(!sec)return;
    var r=sec.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(r.bottom<0||r.top>window.innerHeight)return;
    var off=((r.top+r.height/2)-(window.innerHeight/2))*.08;
    off=Math.max(-45,Math.min(45,off));
    img.style.transform='translateY('+off+'px)';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.fu').forEach(function(el){
    if(el.getBoundingClientRect().top<window.innerHeight*.9)el.classList.add('v');
  });
},{passive:true});

function typewriter(cfg){
  var ti=0,ci=0,del=false,el=document.getElementById(cfg.id);
  if(!el)return;
  function tick(){
    var txt=cfg.texts[ti];
    if(!del){el.textContent=txt.slice(0,ci+1);ci++;if(ci===txt.length){setTimeout(function(){del=true;tick();},3400);return;}}
    else{el.textContent=txt.slice(0,ci-1);ci--;if(ci===0){del=false;ti=(ti+1)%cfg.texts.length;setTimeout(tick,380);return;}}
    setTimeout(tick,del?16:45);
  }
  tick();
}
twData.forEach(typewriter);
